name: tvslim
description: Read your Android TV or Google TV through TV Slim for Windows: packages, catalogue, journal and drift. Read-only.
long_description: TV Slim debloats Android TV and Google TV devices over ADB, reversibly. With this extension, Claude reads the television through TV Slim for Windows on this PC: what it runs, what TV Slim's catalogue says about each package and what disabling it breaks, what TV Slim changed, and what a system update turned back on. It changes nothing on the television: disabling, re-enabling and installing stay in the TV Slim app, behind its safeguards. Requires TV Slim for Windows 1.7.0 or later.

executable.title: TV Slim.exe
executable.description: TV Slim for Windows, 1.7.0 or later. The installer puts it in AppData\Local\TV Slim; for the portable version, pick the TV Slim.exe it was unzipped with.

tools.name: find_tvs
tools.description: Lists the TVs TV Slim can reach on the local network.

tools.name: get_tv_overview
tools.description: Reads a TV: model, Android version, memory, home screen, catalogue packages and drift.

tools.name: list_tv_packages
tools.description: Lists the catalogue packages present on a TV, with state, risk and side effects.

tools.name: get_unknown_packages_report
tools.description: Inventory of the system packages the catalogue does not describe.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: What TV Slim did to a TV from this PC, newest first.

tools.name: check_drift
tools.description: Packages TV Slim disabled that are active again, and a home screen that fell back.

tools.name: describe_package
tools.description: What the catalogue says about one package, without reading any TV.
